notes: Sourced from Analog Way's official technical datasheet (PLS4K_EN, rev. 05/07/2024, and 09/01/2022) plus the analogway.com product page. Ports 5-6 are user-selectable per input: each of the two channels physically exposes one HDMI 1.4 jack AND one 3G-SDI BNC jack, but only one is active at a time (selectable in menu) - modeled here as two separate physical connectors per manufacturer's rear-panel diagram. The Genlock connector is described by Analog Way as "1 dedicated BNC with loop" for Genlock/Blackburst/tri-level sync - modeled as one BNC input plus one BNC loop-through output (2 physical BNC jacks visible on rear panel). The Multiviewer output is a dedicated 3rd output (HDMI 1.4 + mirrored 3G-SDI), separate from the 2 PGM/AUX outputs. Ethernet is a single Gigabit RJ45 (Neutrik) for control/API, distinct from the optional Dante card's dual RJ45s. The optional Analog+Dante audio card (not standard/base) adds 2x 3.5mm TRS stereo line-in, 2x 3.5mm TRS stereo line-out, and 2x RJ45 (Dante primary/secondary, AES67) - included here as it is a documented factory option with fixed rear-panel cutout; omit if strictly base-unit-only is desired. Power inlet connector type is not explicitly named as "IEC C14" in the datasheet text, but the rear-panel photo shows a standard IEC AC inlet with an integrated fuse-drawer module (rated 100-240VAC 3A 50/60Hz, F4A 250VAC fuse, 95W max consumption per the 2024 datasheet, revised up from 80W in the 2022 datasheet) - inferred as iec (C13/C14 family) with high confidence given standard AV rack-gear convention. No grade is stated for RJ45 beyond "Gigabit Ethernet," so eth-1g is used. HDMI 1.4/2.0 and SDI grades are explicitly stated per port in the datasheet. DisplayPort grade (1.2) is explicit. No USB speed is stated for the USB-A host port (used for firmware/config import-export only), so grade is omitted.
